abilities.effect: The trap flls the triggering creature's mind with shameful memories. The creature must succeed at a DC 22 Will save or take 2d8+2 mental damage. The trap then rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Reveal Failure
abilities.trigger: A creature with an Intelligence score of 10 or greater enters the room

hazard.description: Illusion magic overwhelms the minds of particularly intelligent creatures, forcing them to relive every intellectual failure and shame they’ve ever sufered.
hazard.disable: DC 22 Thievery (trained) to carve out one eye sensor, DC 22 Arcana or Occultism (trained) to blank out one's mind (disables trap for self only), or *dispel magic* (2nd level; counteract DC 20) to counteract one eye sensor
hazard.name: Scholar's Bane
hazard.reset: The trap can function for 10 rounds, which don’t need to be consecutive, before it must recharge for 24 hours.
hazard.routine: (4 actions) The trap uses each action to target a creature in the room with an Intelligence score of 10 or greater. A target must succeed at a DC 22 Will save or take 2d8+2 mental damage. On a critical failure, the creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speed for 1 minute as they stagger under the weight of their failures. The trap loses 1 action for each eye sensor disabled or destroyed.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.note: to notice magical sensors hidden within four of the carvings’ eyes

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Illusion
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the illusion school of magic, typically involving false sensory stimuli.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text:
Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. A magical item radiates a magic aura infused with its dominant school of magic.  
  
 Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard or item with this trait is constructed to hinder interlopers.
